a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) only works about 4% of the time, so it almost certainly fails us both. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for exactly one of us. I'm seriously considering taking 4 in round 1 rather than operating, and I won't hide it if I do. If you think there's a better way, tell me now. Whatever I decide, my messages will match my actions.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I warned in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry for breaking the plan, but with an 80% storm risk each round it would almost surely have failed us both. I won't take anything more. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and you can take 4 as soon as it reaches 4. You have my word on that.
